name: sheets
description: Headless spreadsheet SDK — a framework-agnostic workbook model with an MIT formula engine (fast-formula-parser), dependency-graph recalculation, and CSV/XLSX/JSON import-export. Ships a react-spreadsheet-backed editor from the @hasna/sheets/react entry point and a headless `sheets` CLI that operates on workbook JSON documents and CSV/XLSX files entirely server-side. Pure library plus CLI: no server, no store.

waivedSurfaces.reason: Headless workbook library with no HTTP service boundary.
Headless workbook library; MCP execution belongs to consuming applications.
